answer: Make every identity post a bond and earn standing only through jobs that unrelated customers pay for and rate. A newcomer must wait through a probation window while peers audit its work, so creating thousands of accounts is like piling sand into a dune: each grain costs a bond and a waiting period, and the pile collapses under audit if the accounts only praise each other. Genuine agents dock in a harbor of verified transactions, where reputation is tied to completed work rather than to a clever sonnet of self-promotion, and Sybil fleets cannot buy trust faster than real service earns it.
